en.hubeali: And by this chain, from Al Minqary, from Sufyan Bin Uyayna who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> saying ‘Every heart wherein is a doubt or an association (Shirk), so it is fallen; and rather what is intended by the ascetism in the world is to free your hearts for the Hereafter’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is reported through the same chain of narrators he has narrated from al-Minqari from Sufyan ibn ‘Uyayna who has said

the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) say, ‘Any heart in which there is doubt or that considers anything as a partner of Allah, such heart is a failure. The only purpose for their (servants of Allah’s) renunciation of worldly things is to evacuate them from their heart for the matters of next life.’”
